display.purpose: Page headings at the md scale.

label.purpose: Nav, metadata, footer, placeholders. Same face as body, secondary color.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Light-theme resting shade on fields and buttons. Dark theme uses 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45).

components.name: Button
components.description: Hairline button. Orange appears only on the border, on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #f7f7f4; color: #26251e; font-family: Switzer, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.16); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.06); transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #f54e00; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f54e00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Paper field with a hairline and an orange focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #f7f7f4; color: #26251e; font-family: Switzer, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.16); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.06); caret-color: #26251e; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5b56; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f54e00; outline: 2px solid #f54e00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav link
components.description: 14px quieter ink. The current page is full ink. No underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { color: #5c5b56; font-family: Switzer, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav[aria-current=page] { color: #26251e; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f54e00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section title
components.css: .ds-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-title h2 { margin: 0; color: #26251e; font-family: Switzer, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 2.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-title-rule { width: 128px; height: 1px; background: rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.16); }

narrative.overview:
The site should feel as quiet as cursor.com and softwire.com: a warm sheet of paper, type that sits on it without shouting, and almost no color. Light and dark are two finished rooms, not a mechanical invert. Light is a warm sheet (#f7f7f4) with warm-black ink (#26251e). Dark is a warm night (#14120b) with ivory type (#edecec).

The old cool gray and purple system is retired. Purple avatar rings, teal accent text, and the Chakra-style slate text colors do not belong in later passes.
keyCharacteristics: One grotesque family, Switzer, at regular and medium weights.
Ink does the hierarchy. Orange appears a few times per page at most.
Structure is a hairline, not a shadow or a filled card.
Secondary text is the same hue as the ink, stepped quieter.
Skill-icon brand colors are content, not chrome.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is not a theme color. Do not use it for body copy, headings, or large fills. On Paper it is 3.3:1, enough for a control or a large mark, not for small text.

rules.name: The Same-Hue Text Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is a step of the active ink. Do not introduce cool gray, blue-gray, or Tailwind gray-* for type or borders.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Use 400 and 500. Reach for 600 only when a single word must separate from a medium heading. Do not set headings in 700 or 800.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Load Switzer only, weights 400, 500, and 600, from public/fonts. Do not add Geist, Roboto, Open Sans, Manrope, or a display serif unless the task explicitly changes the type system.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows to cards, portraits, or sections to create depth. A hairline or a one-step surface change is the depth system.

dos: Do keep both themes, and set every new color as a pair on .light and .dark in styles/globals.css.
Do use text-primary for anything the reader must read, and text-secondary for chrome and metadata.
Do use border-line and bg-line for structure.
Do append a dated iteration to AGENTS.md after a design pass, and update this file when a token changes.
Do check body text at 4.5:1 and large text or controls at 3:1 in both themes.
donts: Don't bring back purple, teal, or cool slate as the site palette.
Don't use Signal Orange for paragraphs, links in running text, or large backgrounds.
Don't load a second font for headings.
Don't restyle layout, spacing, or copy during a color or type pass.
Don't recolor skill icons or employer logos. Their brand hues are content.
